howto.name: Upload a WebM clip
howto.text: Drop a .webm file. Keep it short — every GIF frame is stored as its own image.

howto.name: PrivaTools samples frames via FFmpeg
howto.text: Every GIF frame is stored as its own image, which is why short clips work and long ones do not.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Frames are reduced to a 256-colour palette. GIF trades size and colour depth for the ability to autoplay in email and old chat clients.

faq.q: Why is the GIF larger than the WebM?
faq.a: GIF stores every frame as a separate image and is capped at 256 colors, so it's inefficient — a short WebM can become a much larger GIF. Trim the clip first to keep the size down.
No — GIF is a silent image-animation format and cannot contain audio.
Keep it under about 6–10 seconds; longer clips produce very large GIFs.
